_comment: MOS-303 — fixture for getFinancialStatements() row parser. The `content` field is the HTML datatable body returned by GET /financial/statements?PR[]=<id>. The real BuildTools layout puts an empty/icon cell at cells[0], the status label at cells[1], the human-readable statement name at cells[2], then amount, paid, fees, balance, date. All IDs and names are scrubbed of real customer data — names use the placeholders already invented in other fixtures (Smith Renovation, Q1 2026 Statement, fake 7xxxxx IDs).
